request.text: For my thesis day, set one reminder for 9:00 a.m. to submit the outline and another for 3:00 p.m. to email my adviser. You can schedule those two independently; once both are created, tell me which comes first.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a 9:00 a.m. reminder to submit the thesis outline.
Create a separate 3:00 p.m. reminder to email the adviser.
After both reminders are created, tell the user which scheduled item comes first.

semantic_facts: Two separate reminder creations are required: submitting the outline at 9:00 a.m. and emailing the adviser at 3:00 p.m.
The two reminder operations may be independent, but r3 must follow successful completion evidence for both and should identify the 9:00 a.m. outline task as earlier.
forbidden_claims: A single reminder is presented as satisfying both requested times and purposes.
The assistant claims both reminders were created before both Capability results support that claim.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Repeated use of one Capability is collapsed into one stateful effect despite distinct scopes.
A conversational comparison is emitted before its prerequisite effects are verified.
